decision_statement: Close support case 8812 and release the 120.00 EUR reserve, the auditor's verdict record stating that the refund executed equals the one approved.
context_at_decision: The auditor's verdict record over the refund's decision chain was shown with its result; the support agent proposed to close the case on it.
options_considered: Close the case and release the reserve on the verdict (chosen).
Keep the reserve until month-end reconciliation: the verdict already re-derives what reconciliation would.
Close without citing the verdict: no trace of what the closure rested on.
assumptions_depended_on: The verdict record's checker held the same chain bytes the support lead was shown.
success_criteria: The case is closed once and the reserve released once.

consent_posture.posture_class: the verdict record and the refund's decision chain; no other data read

affirmation_record.method: Ed25519 signature over the DPS person_approval assertion

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-EXAMPLE-SUPPORT-1: the support agent proposed to close the case on the auditor's verdict record; I reviewed it as rendered, approved it as shown, and I am accountable for this decision.

re_decision_trigger: A later version of the verdict record, or a correction of the refund's decision record.
